$comment: Where this build believes it is served from. No domain has been chosen, so canonicalOrigin is null and every absolute URL is a preview origin, marked as such in the HTML. Set canonicalOrigin to a real origin and the next build emits canonical links, absolute Open Graph URLs and a sitemap.
name: Art of Juan

analytics.note: No analytics, no cookies, no third-party requests. The the brief permits privacy-respecting aggregate analytics as P1; none is implemented, so nothing is disclosed and nothing is collected.
